title: FLUX.3 Block Offload GPU 槽位

standard.summary: Block Offload 时同时驻留 GPU 的 Transformer block 数。默认 2。
standard.effect: 控制 GPU 同时保留的 FLUX.3 Transformer block 数量。
standard.whenToUse: 显存允许时可增加槽位以减少 CPU/GPU 换入；显存紧张时保持较低值。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存余量不足时不要盲目增加。

standard_en.summary: Number of Transformer blocks kept on the GPU during block offload. Default: 2.
standard_en.effect: Controls how many FLUX.3 Transformer blocks remain on the GPU at once.
standard_en.whenToUse: Increase it when VRAM allows to reduce CPU/GPU transfers; keep it low when VRAM is tight.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not increase it without enough free VRAM.
